explication: This repository trains a Transformer language model from raw/tokenized data through pretraining and alignment, then exposes evaluation and chat. The principal workflow is: prepare token data, optimize the base model, apply SFT and preference/reinforcement stages, save checkpoints, and generate or evaluate responses. The graph preserves the documented DPO, PPO, GRPO/RLVR, GSM8K, and Streamlit capabilities. Some stage entrypoint wiring is inferred from the README because the sampled excerpts do not include the training scripts’ bodies.
